interpretation: Target initialization starts its dynamic BIOS placement at 0540h; on the applicable machine path it copies optional hard-disk patch code from the same offset. The reference static configuration uses endfloppy as a starting boundary.
limitations: The target code establishes a dynamic boundary but not the exact symbolic name or nature of the nine bytes before it. No padding or field names have been invented. Diagnostic includes legacy objects and stubs; target IO.SYS is not yet built.
clarification: The target 0540h dynamic start is not proven to be the endfloppy symbol. Reference link places endfloppy, BData_end and ibm_disk_io at different offsets and both BIOS data segments have word alignment; 9 bytes cannot be attributed to paragraph alignment or to msbio1 alone.
